entries.title: Handbook of Operational Amplifier Applications (Rev. B)
entries.backs: Op amps are used with negative feedback, which sets the gain (p. 7); open loop, any input difference drives the output to saturation and is not practical (p. 14); non-inverting EO = EI(1 + RO/RI) (p. 17); inverting EO = −(RO/RI)EI (p. 18); difference amplifier EO = (RO/RI)(E2 − E1) (p. 74).
